title: Puberty: Physical Changes and Open Dialogue
summary: Puberty begins early (ages 9-12). Changes include growth in height, voice deepening, body hair, and menstruation/wet dreams. Parents: initiate dialogue before school or the internet does. Father with son, mother with daughter. Use scientific language—no shame, no mockery. A trusted book should be the reference.
try_this: This week: Read together a chapter from a reliable puberty book (such as "My Body is Changing" or its equivalent). Discuss: What surprises you? What scares you?
reflection_prompts: What question did your child ask that surprised you?
Did they feel at ease after the conversation?
warning_flags: علامات بلوغ مبكرة جداً (<9 سنوات) أو متأخرة جداً (>14 سنة)
